## [Webinars]{#webinars}

<!-- The 2025 fall webinars are jointly presented by SFU's Research Computing Group (RCG) and UBC's -->
<!-- Advanced Research Computing (ARC). -->

The 2025 Fall Webinars, hosted by SFU's Research Computing Group (RCG), take place every second Tuesday at
10:00am Pacific (Victoria, Vancouver), 11:00am Mountain (Edmonton, Calgary), and noon Central
(Winnipeg). Webinar registration opens in early September.

For *upcoming webinars*, click the linked titles to view details or register. For *past sessions*, click the
titles to access recordings and slides.

| DATE | TOPIC | SPEAKER |
| ------------- | --------------- | ----------------- |
| Sep-16 | [<span style="color:blue">Introduction to the Fir cluster</span>](/getting-started#high-performance-computing) | Alex Razoumov |
| Oct-07 | [<span style="color:blue">AI pair programming & LLMs chats in Emacs</span>](/getting-started#emacs) | Marie-Hélène Burle |
| Oct-14 | [<span style="color:blue">Globus-cli for file transfer</span>](/tools/rdm) | Alex Razoumov |
| Oct-28 | [<span style="color:blue">The next generation of Python notebooks</span>](/programming#python) | Marie-Hélène Burle |
| Nov-18 | [<span style="color:blue">Creating interactive online visualizations with Trame</span>](/tools/visualization) | Alex Razoumov | <!-- Nov-11 is a holiday -->
| Nov-25 | [<span style="color:blue">Deep learning experiment tracking with MLflow</span>](/tools/ml) | Marie-Hélène Burle |
| Dec-09 | [<span style="color:blue">Command-line OpenStack</span>](/tools/virtual) | Alex Razoumov |

## [Online courses]{#courses}

SFU Research Computing hosts weekly online sessions on advanced research computing every Thursday from 10:00am
to noon Pacific Time. These sessions are open to all academic researchers in Canada. Most courses span two
weeks, though some may be shorter or longer. Sessions are not recorded to encourage live participation and
interaction. Popular and introductory sessions are repeated throughout the year.

| COURSE | DATES | INSTRUCTOR |
| ------------- | --------------- | ----------------- |
| Introduction to the Unix shell | Sep-11, Sep-18 | Marie-Hélène Burle |
| Introduction to HPC | Sep-25, Oct-02, Oct-09 | Alex Razoumov |
| Introduction to Python | Oct-16 | Marie-Hélène Burle |
| Scientific visualization | Oct-23 | Alex Razoumov |
| Getting started with Git | Oct-30 | Marie-Hélène Burle |
| Working with Apptainer containers | Nov-06, Nov-13 | Alex Razoumov |
| HPC Python | Nov-20, Nov-27, Dec-04 | Alex Razoumov |
| Deep learning with the JAX AI stack | Dec-11, Dec-18 | Marie-Hélène Burle |
